decision: RULING-P99-528 (D-17/D-18 residue): the closing census's 11 surviving occurrences were adjudicated one at a time against the EN source string. 4 rows whose English says "Dossiers" or "countries" were REWRITTEN to the ruled term and are deliberately absent here. The 7 below carry a genuinely different sense and are listed with their exact key path, per the census contract that an occurrence is either rewritten or classified - never silently tolerated.

entries.reason: EN source is "Engagement profile" - a profile field on the organization wizard, not a dossier object.
EN source is "File exceeds maximum size" - upload validation. The base pattern misses it because lowercase 'file' is followed by 'T' in fileTooLarge, matching neither branch.
EN source is "This file type is not supported". The base pattern cannot match a key whose first token is 'file', because ^[^:]+: has already consumed the separator it requires.
EN source is "The file is too large". Same first-token gap in the base pattern.
EN source is "The total file size exceeds the limit". No key-path pattern can ever classify this row - the key carries no file token at all, only the Arabic value does.

EN source is "Create an elected-official dossier to track office, term, and contact details." - elected office, not a stance. Sibling key list.elected_official.description is already ruled this way in the base file.
EN source is "Elected-official dossiers keep office and term information current" - same office sense as its ruled sibling.
